title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15
lineage: SBD > MC > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with hiss/roar that still captures an honest show, highlighted by a smoking Eleven and a slide‑laden Hard to Handle.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source from Bear’s private stash; it isn’t pristine and contains noticeable hiss and occasional roar, but the overall mix is listenable. Musically the concert is solid – Jerry’s lead work on The Eleven and his slide on Hard to Handle draw particular praise, while the early songs and Schoolgirl are viewed as weaker spots.

ai_rating.rationale: Five reviews provide a consistent moderate‑to‑positive picture (average 3.6 stars). Show performance is praised for specific moments, while recording quality is noted as imperfect but acceptable, leading to an overall rating near 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss and roar present; not a pristine reel‑sourced tape. Recorded from Bear’s personal audience collection, so the mix is raw but generally clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A straightforward, honest performance that feels like the band is playing for the dancing crowd rather than a perfect live‑recording audience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Slide work on Hard to Handle and lead passages on The Eleven are highlighted as smiles‑inducing moments.
